PullRequest.Title: fixtures: Filter screenshot comparisons by Light theme labels
PullRequest.Body:
## Summary
- Assign the `screenshot` label by default to non-animated, non-flaky Light fixture variants.
- Select fixtures before CI screenshot capture with `component-explorer render --label screenshot`.
- Use the same label for screenshot reports and blocking baselines; preserve other theme variants in the explorer.
- Skip image downloads and pixel comparisons for excluded fixtures.
- Remove the redundant 300 ms Find widget transition wait and retain only Light blocking baselines, preserving the hashes from main.
- Add regression tests and document the label behavior.

## Pending dependency — required before merge
The capture flag is now wired in, but the pinned CLI does not support it yet. This PR requires microsoft/vscode-packages#315 to merge and publish, followed by a CLI dependency/lockfile bump here. Until then the Capture screenshots step will fail with an unsupported `--label` option.

## Scope
Only fixture-related changes are included, without the customization redesign history. The separate Playwright interaction tests remain unchanged.

## Validation
- Passed: 9 screenshot label/filtering and comment tests.
- Passed: commit hygiene hooks and git diff whitespace checks.
- Passed: baseline exactly matches the Light entries and hashes from main.
- Upstream capture filter passed five command-level selection checks.
- Full compile attempted but blocked by missing Copilot extension dependencies (`esbuild`).
- CI capture with the new flag awaits the updated CLI package.

RegressionFixes.Mechanism: Unbounded Promise.all fan-out performed one remote image download plus one local image read and full-image comparison for each changed fixture before report-label filtering.
RegressionFixes.Symptom: Screenshot-diff CI incurred avoidable network/I/O latency, PNG allocation/CPU, and an aggregate request burst proportional to changed animated or flaky fixtures that were ultimately omitted.
RegressionFixes.FixedBehavior: Filters diff.changed to screenshot-labeled entries before computePixelDiffs, eliminating the HTTPS download, local PNG read, decode, allocation, and pixel scan for every excluded changed fixture.
RegressionFixes.Evidence: Before this PR, main passed every changed manifest entry to computePixelDiffs. That helper maps every entry through Promise.all, issuing one HTTPS GET for the baseline image and one filesystem read for the local PNG, then decodes and walks every pixel. generateMarkdown filtered animated/flaky entries only afterward, so excluded changes paid all boundary and CPU costs despite never appearing in the report. The added filter at head line 522 narrows the input before that call.

RegressionFixes.Mechanism: A fixed 300 ms real-time wait was repeated for each Find widget fixture variant on render and screenshot-capture paths.
RegressionFixes.Symptom: Full fixture capture and individual Find fixture loads were delayed by 300 ms per render; the two fixtures across their default two theme variants contributed four unnecessary waits.
RegressionFixes.FixedBehavior: Returns immediately after constructing and revealing the Find widget instead of keeping each fixture render pending on an additional 300 ms timer.
RegressionFixes.Evidence: The removed base line awaited a 300 ms timer at the end of renderFindWidget after state.change. The function is the render callback for both Find and FindAndReplace, each normally expanded to Dark and Light variants, so full capture paid the fixed wait once per rendered variant even though the fixture adapter already states that component-explorer waits two animation frames after synchronous render. The PR makes the callback synchronous and deletes this delay.

Scenarios.CriticalPath: After build and Playwright setup, the workflow synchronously invokes component-explorer render and cannot proceed to manifest checks or upload until selected fixtures render and screenshots/manifest are written. The new --label screenshot selection and per-Light-variant labels narrow this critical path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Launch component-explorer, browser-backed fixture rendering, and screenshot capture.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One CLI invocation per workflow; internally one render per screenshot-labeled fixture variant. Most ordinary themed fixtures now contribute only the Light variant, while animated and flaky fixtures contribute none.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same single invocation rendered all fixture variants because it had no label filter, commonly Dark plus Light and sometimes additional themes.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The invocation and every selected render must finish before later screenshot steps.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One image per selected Light fixture plus one manifest, rather than images for all theme variants.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Wrote an image for every captured theme variant.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Writes are part of capture completion and determine later archive size.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Zip the current capture and POST one archive to the screenshot service.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One POST when OIDC is available; archive bytes scale with the now-smaller selected screenshot set.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Also one POST, containing screenshots for all rendered variants.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: This later workflow step remains serialized, but its payload is reduced.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of fixture definitions multiplied by theme variants; effective selected cardinality becomes roughly one Light variant per non-animated, non-flaky fixture instead of two default variants plus additional themes.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The upstream renderer's exact worker/browser parallelism is not established in this repository. The diff does not add parallelism or a limiter; it reduces the eligible set before rendering. The Find fixture's removed timer no longer holds an individual render open.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No warm capture cache is visible: each workflow renders and writes the selected set. Label selection acts as pre-work filtering, not a cache. Upload remains one archive with no per-image request fan-out.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: changed workflow, label assignment, and fixture adapter call flow directly establish pre-render selection and reduced variant cardinality.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact fixture count and renderer parallelism are not available from bounded repository search, but there are at least 100 defineComponentFixture call sites and many additional-theme declarations, so the direction and scaling reduction are clear.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The diff removes rendering, filesystem, and upload bytes from the CI critical path.

Scenarios.Scenario: Screenshot diff generation and pixel significance checks
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The workflow fetches one base manifest, then screenshotDiffReport reads both manifests and awaits all requested pixel comparisons before producing the PR comment. The added reportableChanges filter runs before comparisons.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Fetch the base commit manifest from the screenshot service.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One request per workflow when a base SHA is available.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Must complete to perform a visual diff; unchanged by this PR.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Download the baseline PNG for each changed entry that reaches pixel comparison.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One GET per changed screenshot-labeled fixture. Excluded animated/flaky/non-screenshot changes now cause zero GETs.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: One GET per changed fixture before report filtering, including entries omitted from the final report.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: All GETs are awaited before markdown generation.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Read each changed local PNG, decode both PNGs, and scan all pixels.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One local read and two PNG decodes per changed screenshot-labeled fixture; work also scales with image pixel count.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Performed the same work for every changed fixture, even excluded entries.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: All reads and pixel scans complete before report output.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Two manifest reads when a base exists and one report write per invocation.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Small fixed-count local I/O on the serialized report path.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Effective number of changed screenshot-labeled fixtures after filtering, with CPU additionally proportional to total compared pixels.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: computePixelDiffs uses unbounded Promise.all across effective changed screenshot-labeled fixtures; each entry concurrently starts one HTTPS GET and one local read. This concurrency pre-existed, and the diff reduces its aggregate width by excluding non-screenshot entries.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: There is no image cache or coalescing in the script; each unique changed fixture fetches its baseline once per invocation. Warm service/browser caches are not relied upon. The new prefilter is deterministic from manifest labels.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: Very high: computePixelDiffs explicitly maps its input through Promise.all and performs one HTTPS fetch, one fs read, and full pixel iteration per entry.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The number and dimensions of changed images vary by PR, but the old per-excluded-entry GET/read/decode mechanism and its removal are direct.
Scenarios.Verdict: No introduced regression. The PR fixes boundary fan-out and concurrency burst for excluded changes; the prior regression was recorded internally.

Scenarios.CriticalPath: After capture, screenshotBlocksCi synchronously reads the manifest and committed markdown, sorts fixtures, regenerates markdown, and compares strings before the workflow can determine whether blocking baselines changed.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Launch one Node process running screenshotBlocksCi.ts.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The workflow awaits its exit status.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Read manifest and committed baseline markdown synchronously.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Two local reads per invocation; sorting scales with manifest fixture count.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Same reads and sort over the larger all-variant manifest.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Rendered manifest size and number of fixtures carrying both labels; the committed baseline shrinks from all blocking themes to Light blocking entries.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Fully serial synchronous local processing; no subprocess or network call inside the script beyond the workflow's single Node invocation.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache; inputs are read once. Deduplication by fixtureId remains a Set. Requiring both screenshot and blocks-ci only shrinks emitted entries.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High from the complete script and workflow call path.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact byte savings vary with fixture growth, but no new expensive boundary or increased multiplicity is present.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression; CPU, manifest size, and generated markdown are reduced or unchanged.

Scenarios.Scenario: Interactive and capture rendering of Find widget fixtures
Scenarios.CriticalPath: renderFindWidget constructs the editor and FindWidget and reveals state. It now returns immediately; consumers no longer await an extra real-time timer after setup.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Wait on a 300 ms real-time timer after revealing the widget.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Previously one wait per rendered variant: two fixture definitions times two default themes in a full unfiltered capture; now zero.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Each render returned a Promise that could not settle for at least 300 ms.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Previously held each render promise open; the deletion removes it from the critical path.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of rendered Find widget variants and repeated interactive mounts.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Explorer UI may render fixtures in parallel, while screenshot mode controls rendering externally. The removed delay was independently repeated once for each rendered Find/FindAndReplace theme variant.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache is involved; every render reconstructed the widget and previously repeated the timer.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: Very high from the deleted explicit timeout and the two fixtures/default two-theme expansion.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Whether upstream capture serialized or overlapped these timers is not established, so aggregate wall-clock saving may range from 300 ms to 1.2 s for four variants; per-render latency is exactly 300 ms.
Scenarios.Verdict: No regression. The fixed per-render delay is removed and was recorded as an internal regression fix.

Scenarios.CriticalPath: When this build test file runs, suite setup creates a temporary directory and copies three scripts; two tests synchronously launch Node processes and await completion before assertions and cleanup.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Create one temporary tree, copy three scripts, write small JSON/markdown fixtures, and remove the tree.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Fixed three copies, several tiny writes, and one recursive cleanup per suite run.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: This test file and its temporary I/O did not exist.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Test-only setup and cleanup; not on product or screenshot workflow runtime paths.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Launch screenshotBlocksCi.ts once and screenshotDiffReport.ts once under Node.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Exactly two sequential child processes per suite run.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: No subprocesses from this test file.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Adds fixed process-startup latency to this targeted build test suite only.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Potential baseline image fetch by the report subprocess.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Zero in the exercised path: the only changed fixture is excluded before computePixelDiffs, and included entries are added/removed/errored rather than changed.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Without the production filter, the excluded changed fixture would attempt one request to example.invalid until failure/timeout.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The test specifically proves excluded pixel comparisons do not cross the network boundary.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Fixed at two tests and small manifests of five and three fixtures; it does not scale with repository fixture count.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: spawnSync serializes each test subprocess with the test runner thread; there are exactly two invocations in this file. No unbounded fan-out is introduced.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cross-run cache. Files are recreated once per suite and reused by its two tests; cleanup removes all state.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Node startup duration varies by CI host, but cardinality is fixed and small.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable performance regression. The added test-only fixed subprocess cost is bounded and validates removal of a potentially unbounded production boundary.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over all eight changed files and all diff pages. No diff-introduced actionable performance issue was found. The change reduces screenshot render cardinality to stable Light variants, avoids excluded image comparisons, shrinks downstream artifacts/baselines, and removes a 300 ms per-render wait. Recorded the two concrete prior regression fixes with introducing commits.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
